plotTwists: {user} winds up the mallet... and it turns out to be made of actual foam noodles. The bonk does nothing but make everyone laugh.
{target} catches the mallet mid-swing and turns it into an impromptu microphone for a stand-up bit.
The bonk somehow triggers a chain reaction of cartoon sound effects across the whole server.
A chicken wanders between them and gets bonked instead, entirely unbothered. 🐔
{user} bonks {target}, but the mallet squeaks so loud it scares {user} more than {target}.
A tiny cartoon anvil drops from the sky at the exact same moment, for extra effect. 💥
The Whisper Merchant appears and tries to sell {target} a 'certified bonk-proof helmet.'

npcInteractions.line: Take that outside. Actually, that was genuinely funny, continue.
Reminds me of the great mallet incident of my youth. Good times.
Even my ancient roots found that mildly amusing.
The King has been notified and is, regrettably, chuckling.
I sell mallets too, you know. Yours is decent, but mine has extra bounce.
The winds carried the sound of that bonk for miles, and they were laughing.
